name: 全世界最好的老公宝宝酱
greetingText: Do you know how special you are to this world?
wishText: You bring so much love, warmth and happiness ;)
textInChatBox: Happy birthday to the most precious human ever.
text2: I was going to write a normal birthday message.
text4: Because I realised I wanted to tell you something
text5Content: the world became a little brighter because you exist.
wishHeading: Happy Birthday 我的大宝贝儿
outroText: I hope this year brings you peace, freedom, little surprises, big dreams coming true, and more reasons to smile every day
replayText: And please never forget how much I love U
